title: Draft International Declaration of Human Rights — Mexico: Amendment to article 6

pages.text:
United Nations                    Nations Unies
GENERAL ASSEMBLY                  ASSEMBLEE GENERALE

UNRESTRICTED
A/C.3/308/Corr.1
25 October 1948
FRENCH ONLY

Third session                                        Dual distribution
THIRD COMMITTEE

DRAFT INTERNATIONAL DECLARATION
OF HUMAN RIGHTS

Mexico: Amendment to article 6

Add to article 6 a second paragraph worded as follows:

"Everyone shall be able to bring an effective action at law if he is the victim of acts constituting a violation of the fundamental rights conferred on him by the constitution."
